fields.name: height
fields.help: Frame height (px)

fields.name: width
fields.help: Frame width (px)

fields.name: frames
fields.help: Number of frames

fields.name: fps
fields.help: Playback rate for mp4/gif and the explorer; does not change the stimulus

fields.name: carrier
fields.help: pixel = dense noise texture; dots = sparse random dots on grey

fields.name: marginal
fields.help: Distribution of pixel values. At zero shape visibility and equal texture contrast, figure and background pixels have the same marginal distribution

fields.name: p_on
fields.help: P(pixel = hi)

fields.name: lo
fields.help: Lowest value

fields.name: hi
fields.help: Highest value

fields.name: spread
fields.help: Standard deviation (gaussian) or scale (laplace) around 0.5; clipped to [0, 1]

fields.name: levels
fields.help: Number of equiprobable grey levels

fields.name: grain
fields.help: Texel size (px). >1 leaks a lattice cue at the outline

fields.name: blur
fields.help: Spatial correlation of the texture (px). >0 leaks a seam cue at the outline

fields.name: dot_density
fields.help: Dots per px²

fields.name: dot_size
fields.help: Dot diameter (px)

fields.name: dot_polarity
fields.help: Dot colour on grey

fields.name: ink
fields.help: Polarity of the clean, luminance-defined shape

fields.name: form_contrast
fields.help: 1 = clean luminance-defined shape; 0 = the shape is carried only by the texture's motion

fields.name: coherence
fields.help: Temporal coherence of the figure texture: 1 = persists, 0 = resampled every frame

fields.name: coherence_mode
fields.help: refresh: each texel is resampled with probability 1 - coherence per frame. lifetime: fixed lifetime of 1 / (1 - coherence) frames, random phase. ar1: z <- c z + sqrt(1 - c²) noise

fields.name: bg_coherence
fields.help: 1 keeps the background texture unchanged; 0 redraws it every frame. Independent of object coherence unless linked

fields.name: fresh_noise
fields.help: Fraction of independent per-frame noise, never carried by motion

fields.name: coherent_fraction
fields.help: Dots only: fraction of dots that follow their layer; the rest move in random directions relative to it, at its speed

fields.name: texture_gain
fields.help: Figure texture contrast relative to the background. ≠1 is a single-frame cue (no effect on a binary marginal with p_on = 0.5)

fields.name: texture_frame
fields.help: object = texture carried by the shape; world = the shape is a window onto its own flowing texture

fields.name: texture_scale_compensation
fields.help: Keep noise pixels the same size on screen as the object grows or shrinks. The texture still follows object position and rotation; scaling reveals or hides more texture. Off restores pixels that grow and shrink with the shape. Applies to attached pixel textures; world-coordinate textures and dot diameters already stay fixed

fields.name: texture_speed
fields.help: Extra drift of the figure texture (px/frame)

fields.name: texture_direction
fields.help: Drift direction (deg); relative to the object when texture_frame = object

fields.name: bg_motion
fields.help: Background texture motion in the world. matched = speed of object 1, at bg_angle from its heading, so per-pixel temporal statistics match the figure (other objects are not matched)

fields.name: bg_angle
fields.help: Angle between background and figure motion (deg)

fields.name: bg_speed
fields.help: Background speed (px/frame)

fields.name: bg_direction
fields.help: Background direction (deg)

fields.name: ownership
fields.help: hard: a pixel shows the layer covering its centre. dither: chosen with probability equal to the sub-pixel coverage

fields.name: fixate
fields.help: Where the eye looks. screen: a fixed point, as in an ordinary video. object: the eye pursues the target object, which stays at the frame centre while the background and any other object stream past

fields.name: target
fields.help: Object the eye pursues (1 = the first object)

fields.name: gain
fields.label: pursuit gain
fields.help: 1 holds the target still. Below 1 the eye lags, and the target keeps (1 - gain) of its motion on screen

fields.name: bounce_enabled
fields.help: Use one bounce setting for every object, keeping individual choices for when sharing is turned off

fields.name: bounce
fields.label: Bounce at edges
fields.help: Whether every object bounces at the canvas walls while this setting is shared

fields.name: kind
fields.help: glyph = font character; atom = letter built from straight stroke atoms

fields.name: chars
fields.help: Alphabet spec (upper, lower, digits; comma-separated) or literal characters. One is drawn per sample

fields.name: font
fields.help: Font family[:weight], or a path to a .ttf/.otf file

fields.name: size
fields.help: Height (px): cap height of a glyph, side of a square or diamond, diameter of a circle or n-gon

fields.name: thickness
fields.help: Stroke thickness (px)

fields.name: length
fields.help: Bar length (px)

fields.name: aspect
fields.help: Width / height

fields.name: sides
fields.help: Number of polygon sides

fields.name: outline
fields.help: 0 = filled; >0 keeps only the outline, with this width (px)

fields.name: path
fields.help: Path geometry; velocity and acceleration determine travel along it

fields.name: bounce
fields.help: Reflect when the object's visible edge reaches a canvas wall. Oversized objects pan between opposite edge alignments instead of stopping. Independent of path and speed profile; turn off to allow the object to leave the canvas

fields.name: start_x
fields.help: Start as a fraction of the width (circle: centre)

fields.name: start_y
fields.help: Start as a fraction of the height (circle: centre)

fields.name: direction
fields.help: Heading (deg): 0 = right, 90 = down. Phase for circle and lissajous

fields.name: speed
fields.help: Initial linear velocity along the chosen direction or path (px/frame). Negative values reverse travel

fields.name: profile
fields.help: Speed along the path over time

fields.name: speed_end
fields.help: Final speed; the speed ramps linearly from `speed`

fields.name: ramp
fields.help: Fraction of the clip spent accelerating, and again decelerating

fields.name: sine_amp
fields.help: Relative speed modulation

fields.name: sine_period
fields.help: Modulation period (frames)

fields.name: radius
fields.help: Orbit radius (px); positive = clockwise

fields.name: waypoints
fields.help: Random control points of the spline, including the start

fields.name: angle
fields.help: Initial orientation (deg, clockwise)

fields.name: spin
fields.help: Angular velocity (deg/frame)

fields.name: wobble
fields.help: Orientation oscillation amplitude (deg)

fields.name: wobble_period
fields.help: Orientation oscillation period (frames)

fields.name: align_heading
fields.help: Add the instantaneous heading to the orientation

fields.name: scale
fields.help: Initial scale, multiplying the shape's size

fields.name: scale_change
fields.help: Final / initial scale (>1 looms)

fields.name: angle_end
fields.help: Final base orientation in degrees; interpolate from angle over the clip. None keeps the legacy spin behavior. Wobble and heading alignment are additional effects

fields.name: scale_end
fields.help: Final absolute size multiplier; interpolate from scale over the clip. None keeps the legacy relative scale change

fields.name: acceleration
fields.help: Change in linear velocity each frame, along the chosen direction or path. Negative acceleration slows positive velocity and can reverse it. With the constant profile, displacement is velocity × time + ½ × acceleration × time²

fields.name: angular_acceleration
fields.help: Change in angular velocity each frame. Rotation = initial rotation + angular velocity × time + ½ × angular acceleration × time²
